title: Fantastic Spanish Civil War Tour
text: I spent 2 1/2 hours with Rod on the Spanish Civil War tour in Barcelona - he was fantastic and the tour was fun, educational and held my interest the whole time. Rod's enthusiasm and love of what he does came out immediately. I learned some really cool things about George Orwell's role in the war, as well as some insight into Catalonia and overall Spanish history. Rod brought me to some critical locations, and always made sure to answer all of my questions. Just a great time in Barcelona.
author: Kathryn_A

title: I have already recommended it to all my friends
text: I contacted Willy's Plan to take a Civil War Tour in Barcelona (something not to be missed if you come to Barcelona) and the truth is that I ended up delighted with the explanations and curiosities that the guide told us. Everything is easy with this great equipment. Thank you!!
author: Eroless
